description: /locate finds an Entropy Crypt in the Chrono Dawn dimension quickly, and the structure looks right from above and from the side. The player enters the dimension at 0 0 first, so the Time Keeper Village (placed near wherever a player first enters) stays away from what this scenario looks at.

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run locate structure chronodawn:entropy_crypt

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers 0 0 0 1 false ${player}
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers ${x} ${z} 0 1 false ${player}

steps.note: Entropy Crypt in view (its start is at x=${x}, z=${z}), seen straight down from 60 blocks above the start. The start is a corner of the structure, not its center, so it may be off-center or partly out of frame. The surface entrance of the crypt; the rest is underground. Its blocks render with their textures, nothing is cut off at chunk borders, and the ground around it has no box-shaped cut or hollow.

Entropy Crypt from the west, 45 blocks away and about 25 blocks above where the player landed, looking east and slightly down. Its surface entrance sits on the terrain: no floating edges and no deep pit or flat-cut wall around it. The entrance may be small or hidden by terrain from this angle.
